items.name: DNF upgrade
items.install: sudo dnf upgrade --refresh -y && sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/fedora-postinstall-checklist && echo done | sudo tee /var/lib/fedora-postinstall-checklist/dnf-upgrade.done
items.notes: Runs a full package upgrade once and records a local marker.

items.name: LibreWolf
items.install: sudo dnf config-manager addrepo --from-repofile=https://repo.librewolf.net/librewolf.repo && sudo dnf install -y librewolf

items.name: 1Password
items.install:
sudo rpm --import https://downloads.1password.com/linux/keys/1password.asc && sudo sh -c 'printf "[1password]
name=1Password Stable Channel
baseurl=https://downloads.1password.com/linux/rpm/stable/\$basearch
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
repo_gpgcheck=1
gpgkey="https://downloads.1password.com/linux/keys/1password.asc"
" > /etc/yum.repos.d/1password.repo' && sudo dnf install -y 1password

items.name: B60 driver and tooling packages
items.check: rpm -q linux-firmware mesa-dri-drivers mesa-vulkan-drivers vulkan-tools libva-utils libva-intel-media-driver intel-gpu-tools intel-compute-runtime clinfo
items.install: sudo dnf upgrade --refresh -y && sudo dnf install -y linux-firmware mesa-dri-drivers mesa-vulkan-drivers vulkan-tools libva-utils libva-intel-media-driver intel-gpu-tools intel-compute-runtime clinfo
items.notes: Installs Fedora's current firmware, Mesa/Vulkan, VA-API, Intel GPU tools, and OpenCL/Level Zero compute runtime.

items.name: B60 hardware detected
items.notes: Run after installing the physical GPU. If this fails, reseat the card, check power cables, BIOS PCIe settings, and UEFI mode.

items.name: B60 kernel driver active
items.check: lspci -nnk | grep -A4 -Ei 'Arc Pro B60|\bB60\b|Battlemage' | grep -Eq 'Kernel driver in use: (xe|i915)'
items.notes: Recent Intel Arc GPUs normally use the in-kernel xe driver, though some Arc paths may still report i915.

items.name: B60 Vulkan working
items.notes: Confirms Mesa Vulkan can see an Intel/Arc GPU.

items.name: B60 VA-API media working
items.notes: Confirms video acceleration is available through VA-API.

items.name: B60 OpenCL compute working
items.notes: Confirms Intel compute runtime is visible to OpenCL/Level Zero tooling.

items.name: Supabase CLI
items.install: arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) asset=supabase_linux_amd64.tar.gz ;; aarch64|arm64) asset=supabase_linux_arm64.tar.gz ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch"; exit 1 ;; esac; tmpdir=$(mktemp -d) && curl -fL "https://github.com/supabase/cli/releases/latest/download/$asset" -o "$tmpdir/supabase.tar.gz" && tar -xzf "$tmpdir/supabase.tar.gz" -C "$tmpdir" && bin=$(find "$tmpdir" -type f -name supabase | head -n 1) && test -n "$bin" && sudo install "$bin" /usr/local/bin/supabase
items.notes: Uses the standalone Linux amd64 release because Supabase does not support npm -g installs.

items.install:
sudo rpm --import https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc && printf '[code]
name=Visual Studio Code
baseurl=https://packages.microsoft.com/yumrepos/vscode
enabled=1
autorefresh=1
type=rpm-md
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc
' | sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/vscode.repo && sudo dnf install -y code

items.name: Python tooling
items.check: command -v python3 && command -v pip3 && command -v pipx
items.install: sudo dnf install -y python3 python3-pip python3-virtualenv pipx

items.name: Docker
items.install: sudo dnf install -y docker-cli moby-engine docker-compose-plugin && sudo systemctl enable --now docker

items.name: Multimedia codecs
items.install: sudo dnf swap -y ffmpeg-free ffmpeg --allowerasing && sudo dnf group upgrade -y multimedia
